AmountInterval.description:
Discrete integer amount interval in minor units (cents).

``lower``/``upper`` are inclusive or exclusive according to the flags; ``None``
means unbounded on that side.  Bounds are never negative.
AmountInterval.title: AmountInterval

AmountScope.description: Loan scope: currency, loan type, originating office and amount band.
AmountScope.title: AmountScope

AnswerPayload.description: Signed answer record; ``answer_text`` is bound by its hash.
AnswerPayload.title: AnswerPayload

BundleClause.description: Disclosed clause text carried inside a verification bundle.
BundleClause.title: BundleClause

Citation.description: A factual-statement citation bound to a claim revision and its evidence.
Citation.title: Citation

ClaimRevision.description:
Immutable signed payload of one accepted claim revision.

``system_from`` is the *actual* backend receipt time of the source version that
produced this revision; ``system_to`` is deliberately absent — it is derived from
append-only closure events and never written into signed content.
ClaimRevision.title: ClaimRevision

ClauseProof.description: RFC 9162 inclusion proof for one committed clause leaf.
ClauseProof.title: ClauseProof

EvidenceBundle.description: Self-contained verification bundle for one answer.
EvidenceBundle.title: EvidenceBundle

ExportClaim.description: Allowlisted projection of one accepted claim revision.
ExportClaim.title: ExportClaim

ExtractionProvenance.description: How a persisted claim was produced (never contains credentials).
ExtractionProvenance.title: ExtractionProvenance

FederationSubquery.description:
Typed subquery accepted by an office's federation endpoint.

``target_fingerprint`` binds the request to the exact canonical target when the
gateway supplies it; the office rejects a fingerprint that does not match its own
canonicalisation of ``target``.
FederationSubquery.title: FederationSubquery

PolicyRule.description:
Domain-independent statement. All text fields are source excerpts.

This is evidence-grounded extraction, not a proof that the model understood
the obligation correctly. Semantic findings always require human review.
PolicyRule.title: PolicyRule

PolicyScope.description:
Uploader-assigned applicability; textual applicability stays in the rule.

Attributes are explicit categorical boundaries (e.g. jurisdiction/team), not
model-inferred facts. Missing keys mean unspecified, never known equality.
PolicyScope.title: PolicyScope

QueryRequest.description: Public query body.  Tenant and office always come from server context.
QueryRequest.title: QueryRequest

RecordScope.description: Record scope: record class, offices, product and retention starting event.
RecordScope.title: RecordScope

Rule.description:
A normalized rule.

``value`` is an ``int`` for approval counts and a normalized decimal *string*
for retention years; ``unit`` decides which representation is required.
Rule.title: Rule

SourceManifest.description: Immutable, trusted description of one source version.
SourceManifest.title: SourceManifest

SourcePermissions.description: Separate egress decisions: inter-office export vs hosted-model processing.
SourcePermissions.title: SourcePermissions

SupersessionClaim.description: An authorised, explicit replacement relationship declared in the manifest.
SupersessionClaim.title: SupersessionClaim

TargetFacts.description: Explicit typed target facts for a supported query.
TargetFacts.title: TargetFacts

TimeInterval.description: Half-open interval ``[start, end)``; ``None`` end means unbounded.
TimeInterval.title: TimeInterval

VerifiedEvidence.description: Evidence resolved against preserved parser text by the backend.
VerifiedEvidence.title: VerifiedEvidence

BearerAuth.bearerFormat: opaque demo token supplied through environment variables
BearerAuth.description: Protected routes require `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are read from the configured environment and never embedded in this document.

info.description: Meridian backend API. Protected routes use an opaque bearer token mapped to a server-side principal; tenant and office are derived from that principal, never from request fields. Exactly one of `event` or `events` is supplied to the Slack ingestion route. Nullable values are shown as `anyOf` with `null` in the schemas.
info.title: Meridian Office API (DHAKA)
